theme_strategy.archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) blended with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast)
theme_strategy.description: An 'Old Money Tech' aesthetic. Avoids standard SaaS fintech looks (no purple gradients, no soft bubbly cards). Uses editorial tension: highly dense, analytical data mixed with premium cinematic typography. Sharp, authoritative, and cinematic.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Pairing. Extreme contrast between classical authority and digital precision.

headings.usage: H1, H2, Hero numbers, Report titles. Must be used to create an editorial, Wall Street Journal feel.

ui_body.usage: Standard UI text, buttons, navigational elements. Brings a modern, premium punch.

data_tabular.usage: Tickers (e.g., AAPL), live prices, timestamps, tabular data, confidence scores.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing + High Density Data. Mix large dramatic whitespace around sections with tightly packed, grid-aligned data modules.
layout_and_spacing.radii: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px to 4px). Keep edges sharp to enforce the 'Swiss Brutalist' and 'Authoritative' feel.

dashboard_grid.strategy: The 'Control Room' grid. Complete screen utilization. Use border-collapse styles or tight 1px borders between modules to feel like a unified terminal.

layout_and_spacing.containers: Use padding scales like p-6 or p-8 inside bordered modules to prevent text collision.

buttons.primary: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Background matches text-primary (inverted). Hover: slight background shift, text color remains high contrast. Add a 1px inner border for optical crispness.
buttons.quick_actions: For 'Analyze Top 5', 'Analyze Now'. Use 'The Tracing Beam' (Aceternity look) effect on hover—a subtle glowing border traveling around the sharp container edge.

login_signup.layout: Split screen or full-bleed abstract background with an off-center, asymmetrical frosted glass panel (Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-black/60, 1px subtle white/10 border).
login_signup.typography: Massive 'Cormorant Garamond' heading welcoming the user, creating a private-banking feel.

dashboard_main.structure: Bento Grid. Watchlist is the Hero (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8). Alerts Feed is a tall narrow column (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 row-span-2). Performance summary spans the bottom.

watchlist_cards.design: Cardless or strictly rectangular (border-b border-r only). Features a large Mono font ticker, aggressive visual hierarchy for the current price, and a minimal Recharts sparkline taking up the background or right-side of the cell.
watchlist_cards.states: Hover states must include a slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and border color shift to #D4D4D8.

ai_verdict_component.design: Premium, authoritative. NOT a basic progress bar. Use a typographic lockup: Massive Mono font number (e.g., '89%') sitting inside a thin, precise SVG radial ring. The ring's stroke color matches the Buy/Sell/Hold signal color.
ai_verdict_component.text: The recommendation (BUY/SELL/HOLD) must be an uppercase badge (text-xs) with the corresponding signal background/border from the color tokens.

analysis_report.layout: Editorial newspaper structure. 2 or 3-column CSS grid for text content (AI Reasoning) to prevent overly long line lengths. Large serif drop-caps for the executive summary.
analysis_report.data_viz: Recharts for Historical Performance. Charts must use the specific signal colors, with a transparent background and no grid lines (or very subtle #1E222A grid lines).

alerts_feed.design: Terminal-style feed. Dense. Mono-spaced timestamps. Each item has a 2px solid left border in the signal color (Emerald/Ruby/Amber) to immediately identify the alert type on scan.

empty_states.design: Cinematic. Use the secondary generated image as a dim background. Very minimal text, sharp CTA button to 'Add Stock'. Do not use cute/playful illustrations.

motion_and_interactions.live_data: Use 'animate-pulse' sparingly. When a stock price updates, flash a subtle background color (green or red at 10% opacity) that fades out over 1s.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered reveals using Framer Motion (e.g., transition: { staggerChildren: 0.1 }). Watchlist cards appear sequentially from bottom to top.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Always explicitly define hover text colors. e.g., hover:bg-white hover:text-black.

icons.instructions: Use sharp, stroke-width: 1.5 icons. DO NOT use emoji.

images.description: Abstract slate stone texture with glowing emerald/amber ambient light. Perfect for full-bleed login screens.
Ultra-minimalist dark geometric pattern. Use as a masked background for empty states or the header of the Analysis Report.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements, forms, and key data points MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case. Examples: 'login-submit-button', 'watchlist-card-aapl', 'ai-verdict-score'.
